decisions.statement: A target build is exported only where its companion is known.
A companion no in-game id is known for is left out rather than refusing the whole export.
A build page absent leaves that companion out.
A build with no hash leaves that companion out.
A build's time is exported in whole seconds.
A time that will not parse is taken as the time of the export.
The side file is written whether or not the saved-variables file changes.
No side-file path given answers no hash.
Content already holding every target build is handed back unchanged.
The target build block and the timestamp block share the indent detected from the file.
A caller may hand in the reader of the progress pages.
A caller may hand in the reader of the build pages.
A caller may hand in the writer of the side file.
A caller may hand in the clock.
A caller may hand in where the log lines go.
A caller may hand in what answers who is signed in.
Nothing here writes the saved-variables file.
Nothing here writes out a block keyed by numbers.
The page type the target builds are read from is declared in markdown rather than in TypeScript.

definition: each companion's target build written into the saved-variables file and into a side file
